core_obligations: Forward: assume M-bullet m-pseudo-coherent; the corresponding sheaf complex is m-pseudo-coherent by taking the displayed standard-open approximations, immediate from the definitions.
Converse: E m-pseudo-coherent gives standard opens D(f_i) with strictly perfect E_i-bullet approximating E|_{U_i}; refine so the approximations are actual complex maps to the tilde of M-bullet.
The terms E_i^n are finite locally free, then finite free after refinement; conclude M-bullet_{f_i} is m-pseudo-coherent over A_{f_i} for each i.
Apply the algebra gluing lemma to descend to M-bullet itself.
Pseudo-coherent case: E is m-pseudo-coherent for all m iff M-bullet is, by the algebra lemma applied levelwise.
proof_roadmap: Forward by definition; converse via local approximations; refinement to free terms; algebra gluing; all-m case.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction comparison whose converse needs the full refinement-and-gluing chain; each step is a named input.
